Subject: Payment applied twice on INV-9342 — need correction

Hope you’re well. Quick heads up — our accounts team noticed that the ACH we sent on 2028-01-18 was applied twice against invoice INV-9342 in your AR ledger. We see two cash receipts (CR-20071 and CR-20072) for the same amount (EUR 18,450). Please could you confirm receipt and advise the next steps to have the duplicate reversed and VAT allocation corrected?

Attached is our remittance PDF showing the single payment (stellar_remittance_INV-9342.pdf). We’re happy to coordinate any refund or re-apply once you confirm.

Thanks for flagging, Nina — copying finance leads. Marcus, see attached bank statement extract (bank_statement_20280118.csv) showing two postings from PayOps Gateway for the same ACH. It looks like the payment cleared twice on our bank feed and both receipts were auto-applied.

Action items I propose:
- Reverse the duplicate cash receipt (CR-20072) in NetSuite and move EUR 18,450 back to unapplied receipts.
- Create a reversing journal that reclaims the VAT portion from the duplicate application and posts it to VAT-payable suspense so VAT isn’t double-recognized in the month close.
- Keep StellarApps in the loop and confirm once done so they can resend any remittance if required.

Marcus — can you draft the JE lines (GL/amount/VAT code) and confirm whether we should refund or hold as unapplied? Lauren — want you to sign off on the VAT treatment since this touches EU VAT reporting.

I’ve attached the remittance they sent for traceability.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Jan 2028 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment applied twice on INV-9342 — need correction

Priya — thanks, digging in. Preliminary JE and steps below (will create in NetSuite once we have Lauren's approval):

Proposed reversing journal (to nullify duplicate application CR-20072):
- Debit: Bank Clearing (EUR) 18,450.00 — reverse cash posted by CR-20072
- Credit: Accounts Receivable - StellarApps (EUR) 18,450.00 — re-open invoice balance (INV-9342)

VAT reallocation (split out VAT portion of duplicated application):
- Debit: VAT Payable Suspense (EUR) 3,690.00 — VAT portion (assume 20%)
- Credit: VAT Expense/Contra (EUR) 3,690.00

Net effect: restores invoice + moves duplicated VAT to suspense so EU VAT filing not overstated.

Notes/questions:
- Confirm VAT % (I used 20% as placeholder based on previous records). If StellarApps is reverse-charge, treatment differs.
- Do we refund the duplicate amount or keep unapplied? I recommend keeping as unapplied until StellarApps confirms — avoids refunds and preserves audit trail.

I’ll draft a NetSuite JE template and attach (proposed_journal_entry_netsuite.txt) once Lauren confirms VAT code and approach.

Marcus
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
